title: End things
description: adds a few end things mostly just me messing around but is still fun.
body:
Update to the end! It adds a craftable way to make enderpearls, a new tool type, and ore that is better than netherite! not getting updates UNLESS I forgot to fix somthing like the system to make things with it!
